rationale: Several papers, including 2602.08522, 2607.29562, 2402.16791, 2410.10559, 2503.20002, and 2505.23382, contribute substantive new evidence and propose various models or mechanisms to address the Hubble tension, such as thermal vacuum cosmology, late-time dynamical dark energy, gravitational particle production, early dark energy, and interacting dark sector models. However, no single resolution is universally accepted, leaving the question partially addressed.
